nodes.name: Claude
nodes.does: Most of these systems expose their data and actions to Claude over MCP, so Claude can do real work inside them with each person's own permissions.

nodes.name: MATTER
nodes.does: Project platform for general contractors: RFIs, submittals, bids, contracts and chat in one place, showing who owes the next move.

nodes.name: Delta Portal
nodes.does: Delta Construction's deployment of MATTER. It replaced Procore and runs about 180 active projects.

nodes.name: Delta Estimating
nodes.does: Shows Delta's estimators what they are bidding and when: each bid gets a slot with a name, dates and hours.

nodes.name: Contractor Toolkit
nodes.does: Free Claude Code plugins for contractors. Claude drafts estimates, bid packages, RFIs and daily logs in the company's brand.

nodes.name: C0
nodes.does: Runs Formwork day to day: clients, projects, tasks and invoices in one place, synced with the books.

nodes.name: OutreachSphere
nodes.does: Fills in missing contacts on a lead list, runs email and LinkedIn sequences, and sorts the replies.

nodes.name: ContentSphere
nodes.does: Plans and drafts each client's newsletters, LinkedIn posts and web copy. The client approves every piece.

nodes.name: Thronos
nodes.does: Teams of AI agents that run on a schedule, read a company's systems, draft the work and send each decision to a person.

nodes.name: SIGIL
nodes.does: A synth with six sound engines that runs in a browser tab or as a VST3 plugin in your DAW.

nodes.name: Orbit
nodes.does: Point it at a GitHub repo and it tests the app in a real browser, riskiest journeys first, and explains failures in plain English.

nodes.name: TidyTwo
nodes.does: Shared household app: chores, routines, lists, notes and a family board, with a weekly split of who did what.

nodes.name: PolyQuant
nodes.does: Scans Polymarket and Kalshi for pricing gaps and paper-trades them against live order books before any real money.
